Third-party software in thps.exe
================================

thps.exe is a single program with these libraries linked into it. Their copyright and license
notices follow.

  SDL 2                 zlib license            https://libsdl.org
  PL_MPEG               MIT license             https://github.com/phoboslab/pl_mpeg
  glad (OpenGL loader)  CC0-1.0 / WTFPL, with   https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad
                        Khronos API data under
                        Apache-2.0
  MinGW-w64 runtime     ZPL-2.1 and others      https://www.mingw-w64.org
  GCC runtime (libgcc,  GPL-3.0 with the GCC Runtime Library Exception (no notice required)
  libstdc++)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
glad 2 (OpenGL 3.3 core loader, generated code)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The generated loader is (WTFPL OR CC0-1.0) AND Apache-2.0: the generator's output is public
domain, and the OpenGL API definitions it was generated from are the Khronos Group's XML API
Registry:

Copyright 2013-2020 The Khronos Group Inc.
SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

The full Apache License 2.0 is at the end of this file.
